text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_FLAGS","CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS","SERVER_TCP_FLAGS","TCP_WIN_MAX_IN","TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT","RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"TCP flags, TCP windows, and retransmission features are absent for flows whose IP protocol is not TCP and are represented as zero."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0)"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"The IPv4 ICMP type feature is absent for flows that are not IPv4 ICMP."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256) == df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'])"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"For IPv4 ICMP flows, the encoded type-and-code value has the ICMP type in its quotient upon division by 256."}]}
